name: Tefemburu
description: An overcrowded city destroyed in a trap that annihilated Kaervek's armies.

description_citations.text: "Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruya vows to pin winged creatures to the skies over Tefemburu.
timeline.quote: "If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."

citation.text: Longbow Archer (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hakim's dream-born tale makes the besiegers vanish at dusk.
timeline.quote: The tale wove a spell that caused the creatures besieging the city to vanish completely at dusk.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Dreaming of Victory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A magical trap destroys Tefemburu and Kaervek's armies.
timeline.quote: The trap sprang - a sphere of crackling energy enclosed Tefemburu and exploded, destroying the city and Kaervek's armies.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Dreaming of Victory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Roya vows to pin any winged creature to the skies over Tefemburu.
timeline.quote: If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu.

citation.text: Longbow Archer (Friday Night Magic 2000, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Skies over which Ruya will pin fliers.
